pages.text: $(l:hedges_bestiary:mobs/murk)Murks$(/l) shed their spikes upon growing up, allowing you to craft $(4)Murklevolence$(), a hulking weapon that inflicts the $(4)Volatile$() effect on any unfortunate to be hit.

After slaying three Endgels, their hearts can be gathered to create the $(a)Endgelic Judgement$(), a ranged weapon that consumes eyes of ender to fire the same devastating blasts that Endgels rain upon their victims.
